confirmed_defects: The former main entry point uses hard-coded input and output paths.
The input is parsed by path without recording or requiring an exact SHA-256 snapshot.
JSON, CSV, and PNG outputs are written directly without a transactional bundle publication contract.
The former output omits repository commit, producer byte identities, command, and runtime versions.
The former entry point cannot safely implement the required immutable A-002 rerun acceptance contract.
implemented_contract: Require an expected exact input SHA-256 and verify the same path before and after processing.
Require a clean tracked checkout at an explicit expected repository commit.
Retain explicit amplitude column, convention, and conditional polarity semantics.
Validate one unique output row per source_file_id/run/evt and finite numeric ADC outputs.
Require event-row and stopping-distribution totals to equal the physical-event count.
Repeat exact provenance in the event CSV and expose it visibly and in metadata in the SVG.
Stage the complete JSON/CSV/SVG bundle in a sibling directory and restore the previous bundle after an injected in-process publication failure.
Reject output containment aliases and require explicit overwrite of an existing bundle.

scientific_boundary.reason: Exact A-002 pulse-table and supporting convention/polarity evidence bytes were unavailable; BLK-AMP-001 remains open.

regression_coverage: injected transactional publication failure and rollback
